failure.body:
**Description**

I am following the build instruction in ansible/doc/README.testbed.Setup.md.
I have reached the step to build the sonic-mgmt repository.
Here are the instructions:
    git clone --recursive https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage.git
    make configure PLATFORM=generic
    make target/docker-sonic-mgmt.gz

The git clone looks like a cut and paste error from the building of the sonic-buildimage above.
And if you try to make configure, it fails.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1.  git clone --recursive https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt.git
2. cd sonic-mgmt
3.  make configure PLATFORM=generic

**Describe the results you received:**
caglab@caglab-sonic:~/sonic-mgmt$ make configure PLATFORM=generic
make: *** No rule to make target 'configure'.  Stop.

**Describe the results you expected:**
I expected a build to be done.
